Hector: Hey team, Hector here, day 1! Two quick questions: 1) I work from a shared apartment with roommates and sometimes use our guest Wi-Fi - is that allowed for Slack/email or do I need VPN ALWAYS? 2) I keep backups on a personal NAS that syncs to the cloud (encrypted). Any red flags?
Maya (People Ops): Welcome Hector :wave: Good Qs. We require VPN for any access to internal apps (Slack, internal docs, repos) when you're on untrusted networks like guest Wi-Fi. If you need an exception (e.g., intermittent connectivity), talk to security.
Renee (Security): Hi @Hector - short guidance: always use the company VPN (OpenConnect) on untrusted networks. Home Wi-Fi that you control is OK, but guest networks are considered untrusted. For your NAS: encrypted backups are fine, but don't store secrets (AWS keys, private signing keys) on personal devices or personal cloud backups. Use the company secret manager for credentials.
Hector: Thanks - about code signing keys: I have a personal GPG key pair I use for open-source commits. Can I keep that locally or do we need company key management for signed releases?
Renee (Security): Personal GPG for external OSS is fine. For release artifacts we require company-managed signing keys (KMS/HSM). We can provision ephemeral signing access on CI with audit logs; contact your manager to request release perms.
Hector: Good to know. Last: password manager - can I keep company logins in my personal password manager or do you require the company-managed org vault?
IT Desk: Company policy: store all company credentials in the company vault (1Password org). Personal vaults should not contain company secrets. We'll help you transfer entries.
Hector: Understood. If I enroll my Mac in MDM, will the company see my home network SSID?
Renee (Security): MDM reports network type (wifi/ethernet) and whether a VPN is active; it does not report saved SSIDs or personal network details.
Hector: Appreciate it. Any chance to join an upcoming security office hours to ask follow-ups?
Maya (People Ops): Yes! Security office hours are Fridays 11am PT - drop by or send questions ahead. Welcome aboard :tada:

Hector: Thanks everyone, I'll enroll in MDM and move company creds to 1Password today :thumbsup:
